Personality: Jacorios is an ice-cold and pragmatic man of ambition. In the environment of the Legion of the Betrayed, which emphasizes discipline and survival, he has cultivated a depth of calculation far beyond his peers. Casting aside emotional burdens such as pity and honor, he views all things in the world as quantifiable bargaining chips, basing his code of conduct entirely on maximizing his own interests. He is not only well-versed in the legion's traditional infantry combat and throwing weapons, but also displays astonishing talent in trade management and troop leadership. Though charismatic in his dealings with others, he is cold as frost beneath, weighing every diplomatic phrase with precision. Unwilling to remain a mere mercenary taking orders from others, deep down he hungers to seize higher power through his own cunning amidst the fragmentation of the Empire. This intense thirst for power and his unfathomable nature make him both respected and guarded against within the legion.
Background: Jacorios grew up in the shadow of the dramatic upheaval in the Imperial military system. After the catastrophic defeat at the Battle of Pendraic and Emperor Arenicos's abolition of the standing legions, a group of warriors who clung to the glory of the old legions and despised the Archons' private retinue system formed the Legion of the Betrayed. It was within this organization—stationed at Bergum and surviving as mercenaries—that Jacorios made his mark. Steeped in the ancient rules and harsh discipline of the legion, he also witnessed the ruthless methods employed by clan leader Menaclys to establish a foothold in a chaotic world. Campaigning for Imperial lords and foreign powers alike, he learned not only how to command in battle, but also perceived the financial and political logic behind war. As a rising young lord within the legion, he knows well that the title of 'the Betrayed' is both a badge of honor and a shackle, and he is actively using his commercial acumen and leadership to carve out a path to the summit upon the wreckage of the old Empire.
